description: Plan 9.6 / X-MB5 acceptance: a floating cube (a = 0.2 m, 0.4 kg, RigidBody3D + PoseIntegrator3D) with four pyramid reaction wheels (each 0.25 kg RigidBody3D on a Revolute3D behind an ElasticShaft, CurrentControlledDrive k_t = 0.1 N m/A) and compliant ContactPoints (Hunt-Crossley, Coulomb) on all eight vertices over a ContactSurface. `sequence-contact` runs a scripted face -> edge -> corner sequence (TipSequencer, Allocator, 1 ms): rests on the face, tips onto an edge (45 deg), holds, tips onto a corner (atan sqrt 2), holds. `edge-contact` and `edge-switched` run the edge phase on the vertex contacts and on a SwitchedPivot3D in edge mode, with the same wheels and firmware; the cross-model comparison pins them together.

still at rest at the end of the face phase: sum f_n = m_total g (measured ratio 1 - 5e-8)
